conventions.percent: values with unit % are percentages 0-100, not fractions
conventions.KB: kilobytes of encoded transfer (1 KB = 1000 bytes)
conventions.score: CCL.CTA_SALIENCE and CCL.VISUAL_COMPLEXITY are 0-100 composites; CCL.READABILITY is Gulpease (it) or Flesch (en); CLS is unitless
conventions.not_applicable: an Observation with assessed=false and a reason starting with 'not_applicable' removes the KPI from coverage
conventions.per_profile: a KPI with rows on two or more profiles is aggregated per profile with its own aggregate (rows without a profile join every profile) and the overall value is the profile whose value scores lowest on these anchors; profiles the anchors cannot score are ignored unless none can be scored (then rows are pooled); DPR confidences are pooled (max). KpiScore.profile names that profile only when it scores strictly worse than every other; ties keep the first profile in observation order, unnamed
conventions.sum: sum adds every row of a profile (plus rows without a profile): producers emit one row per distinct page, so with repeats > 1 they report the median over repeats per page instead of one row per visit
conventions.points: piecewise-linear [[value, score], ...], clamped to the first and last score
conventions.map: bool, enum and label KPIs map the value to a score; a null score means not applicable
